title: finding(app-shell): Studio offers Edit on a packaged item of a type the OS_METADATA_WRITABLE hatch elevates, and the server refuses the save (ADR-0131 D6: the hatch never opens a managed item)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible product defect with a named producer. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560, `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`). The source is the out-of-scope finding in the objectui#12141 dev report (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12168), class (b). ⛔ Not a claim.

objectui#12141 says "Whether this gate should read more than the flag is this lane's call". This seat ruled it out of #12141's scope (a pure rename plus the banner). This card is that call.

## What is wrong

- **Seam:** `spec:allowEnvironmentOverlay` (the type-registry flag, as objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2's describe writes it: the elevation "opens the type's writes of items no managed package ships and never a managed item (ADR-0131 D6)") → `renderer:ResourceEditPage` `canWriteByType` artifact arm, plus the `PermissionMatrixEditor` artifact tier and the "writable" badge in `DirectoryPage` / `PageShell`.
- Those gates read only the flag. When the hatch elevates a type (`allowEnvironmentOverlay: true` with `overrideSource: 'env'`), every item of that type looks editable, including an item a package ships.
- `reach:` named real producer, measured by a probe render. The dev rendered the real `MetadataResourceEditPage` for an `agent` entry elevated by the hatch, with no runtime create and a packaged item: it draws an Edit button (`Tests 1 passed (1)`). The probe was not committed.
- The server's refusal of that save was read from objectstack `main`, not measured live: `SysMetadataRepository.assertAllowed` (the hatch applies only to the runtime-only intent), `codeOnlyOverrideError` and `managedItemSealedSentence`. It is a loud 403, not a silent loss.
- **The user-visible effect:** an admin is offered an edit that fails on save.

## Done when

- On a hatch-elevated type, a packaged (managed) item opens read-only in the editor, and the permission matrix's artifact tier agrees. An item no package ships stays editable.
- The "writable" badge does not claim more than that.
- Pins:
  - a hatch-elevated type with a packaged item → read-only;
  - the same type with a runtime-only item → editable;
  - CONTROL: a registry-opt-in type (`overrideSource: 'registry'`) → as today.
- No new client-side copy of the server's seal rule if a served field already carries it. The claim measures what `/meta/types` and the item read serve first.

## Who acts, and in what order

- The `domain:ui` execution seat, after triage grades this card.
- Serial: after PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12168 (objectui#12141) lands, because it renames the field these gates read. objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2 carries the describe sentence.

## Dedupe

Two repo-scoped semantic issue searches on objectui, open and closed:
- "Studio edit button offered for packaged managed item when OS_METADATA_WRITABLE hatch elevates type, save refused 403 managed content seal": 14 hits.
- "artifact tier write gate canWriteByType overrideSource env hatch packaged item read-only": 7 hits.

No open hit except objectui#12141, which carries the rename and not this gate. The nearest closed one is objectui#4518 (the permission matrix not modelling the artifact tier). It predates ADR-0131 D6, which changed what the hatch opens.
